info.title: x32-control-api
info.description:
Control API for Behringer X32 / Midas M32 consoles over OSC.

Every value in this API is in engineering units — dB, Hz, milliseconds, percent —
and every field name carries its unit. The console's raw 0.0–1.0 floats never
cross this boundary.

Two conventions worth knowing before wiring a UI to it:
- `muted` is what it says; the console itself stores the inverse (`/mix/on`).
- A fader at -90 dB is -∞, i.e. fully closed.

lastSyncAt.description: Epoch ms of the last full sync.

lastFeedAt.description: Epoch ms of the last message from the parameter feed.

dryRun.description: When true, state-changing OSC is logged instead of sent.

address.description: Where to send the probe. Defaults to OSC_BROADCAST_ADDRESS.

timeoutMs.description: How long to listen for answers, in ms.

rttMs.description: How long the console took to answer, in ms.

id.description: Id to address this console by. Defaults to "default" for the first one.

unparsed.description: Containers whose dump did not match the schema and were re-read one parameter at a time. A non-empty list means this firmware prints a container differently than expected — worth reporting.

source.description: Input source index. Channels and aux inputs only.

muted.description: True when the strip is muted. The console stores the inverse.

monoLevelDb.description: Send level to the mono main, in dB.

pan.description: Send pan, where the destination is stereo.

gainDb.description: Head amp gain in dB. Channels fed by a local XLR input only.

ratio.description: Ratio. Values off this list snap to the nearest the console offers.

id.description: Strip id, as used in URLs.

sends.description: Bus sends, or matrix sends on a bus.

gainDb.description: Head amp gain. Channels on a local input only.

ratio.description: Snapped to the nearest ratio the console offers.

at.description: Epoch ms this frame was assembled.

channels.description: dBFS for input channels 1-32, in order.

values.description: Every slot in the bank, in dBFS. Use this to identify slots the mapping does not cover yet: feed one input and watch which index moves.

confirm.description: Must be "OVERWRITE". Saving replaces whatever is in that slot.

apply.description: Send it to the console. Without this the request only reports what it would do.

rampMs.description: Ramp time for level changes, in ms.

ramped.description: Whether this value was ramped rather than jumped.

changed.description: Values that actually differed and were sent.

unknownLines.description: Lines this project has no schema for — routing, effects, and the like.

rejectedLines.description: Lines whose value count disagreed with the schema. These are never decoded by position, because every value after a mismatch would land on the wrong parameter.

connected.description: Of those, how many are usable right now.

dryRun.description: DRY_RUN is on: no state-changing OSC is sent.
